title: Add UK budget explanations and drafts
body: ## Summary - Added PP budget explanation files for May to September under `解释说明/` (`2605解释.txt` through `2609解释.txt`), written mainly in Chinese while retaining necessary system/item names. - Added May through September application email drafts in both `.txt` and `.docx` formats under `申请邮件/`, following the February/March/April message template and suitable for copying into Outlook 2016. - Updated the September application email to use the quoted warehouse racking repairs amount of £1,125 instead of the previous £5,000 estimate, and recalculated the monthly and overall totals. - Added James reminder/follow-up emails on warehouse racking repairs. - Updated the May through September workbook Summary sheets to use the unified Exclude VAT convention. ## Checks - Recalculated the revised September application email totals: - Monthly Opex: `£31,779.00` (`£27,500` routine + `£1,125` racking + `£2,866` shower + `£288` eyewash) - Recurring: `£19,273.00` - Total: `£51,052.00`
